title: Read unoptimized add assembly
description: This assembly sets up a stack frame, adds the parameters, and returns the result.

steps.description: The function label starts add. The prologue saves the caller's base pointer and creates this stack frame.
The parameters move from registers to stack locations, then load into edx and eax.
addl adds the values and leaves the result in eax by convention.
The epilogue restores the base pointer and returns to the caller.
